sonnet.problem: The text of verse 11 says only 'They dress the wound of the daughter of My people'. It does not say who 'they' are. The card says God is describing how 'the prophets and priests' treat His people, and card 2's question repeats this ('The prophets and priests dress the ___'). That ties the verse to the prophets and priests when the text leaves it open.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply the next word of a line ('vipers that cannot be ___'). The choices are 'charmed', 'caught' and 'seen'. None of them can be reasoned out from anything the cards have told, so the baker can only guess the wording.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
